Real bugs found and fixed during live testing (not caught by mocks alone):
1. Custom dialer picked only ips[0] from LookupIP; 'localhost' resolved to ::1 first but llama-server/mlx_lm.server bind IPv4-only, causing 'connection refused'. Fixed: dialer now tries all resolved IPs in order (Happy-Eyeballs-style fallback).
2. mlx_lm.server treats the request 'model' field as a HF repo ID to load (unlike llama-server, which ignores it) — requires LOCAL_LLM_MODEL=default_model to use the server's --model. Documented prominently in docs/DEVELOPMENT.md.
3. Reasoning-enabled Gemma checkpoints stream chain-of-thought via a non-standard 'reasoning' delta field (separate from 'content') on mlx_lm.server; for the skills' large system instructions this can consume the entire max_tokens budget (mlx_lm.server default 512) before any content is produced, yielding empty responses. Fixed by adding configurable max_tokens (default 4096) to requests; documented mlx_lm.server's --chat-template-args '{"enable_thinking":false}' as the practical mitigation (cut generation from minutes to seconds in testing).
